## Context / Problem
Eighteen provider, lifecycle, build, cache, and tracing test modules contain 48 current prose blocks: 39 leading docstrings and 9 full-line comment regions (4,854 before-words), based on `origin/main@f0ebace0b5d88e004a8b370f612501437365eccd`. Historical audit `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84` remains provenance; current-parent blobs define citations and word counts. Revalidation keeps the current `structured_run._import_pydantic_ai` seam and the current `bridge status` literal; neither executable correction is prose scope.

## Approach
Edit only the frozen prose blocks below. A `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` in a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`. A `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal consecutive full-line COMMENT-token region, owned by the innermost AST scope and anchored to the next unchanged non-comment code. Compact `D{a,b}` and `C{scope@anchor,...}` notation expands to those exact IDs under the row's path; the reviewer writes the fully path-qualified `<path>#<ID>`.

For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstring nodes; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` values to match. Tokenize both blobs and reject changed inline comments or non-allowlisted full-line comments. Preserve runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Only adjacent blank-line normalization around an edited block is allowed.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py` — `D{<module>,test_supports_temperature_defaults_true_for_everything_else,test_warns_when_caching_was_requested_but_both_counters_are_zero,test_bedrock_builder_sets_exactly_the_two_parity_cache_keys,test_bedrock_model_id_config_field_is_gone,test_bedrock_region_knob_is_untouched,test_default_model_opus_4_8_withdraws_temperature,test_sonnet_retains_temperature_support,test_direct_anthropic_opus_also_withdraws_temperature,test_botocore_still_ignores_aws_region_but_rebar_now_closes_the_trap,test_this_checkout_pins_the_region_beside_its_region_scoped_model_pins}`; `C{<module>@def _stub_bedrock_provider,<module>@@contextlib.contextmanager,<module>@def _spy_boto_session,<module>@def _region_pinned_project}`
- `tests/unit/test_blocking_relation_partition.py` — `D{<module>,test_neither_site_re_lists_relation_names}`

## Protected false positives
All unlisted prose is protected, including the concise at-or-above-floor boundary rationale at `test_cache_floor_warning.py:69-70` and the full-length/proper-prefix comment before the second assertion in `test_effective_cache_prefix_is_the_single_validity_predicate`. Preserve every noqa/type-ignore/pragma directive, provider/model/config literal, measured counter/value, external URL, and assertion. The published cache-floor URL and model/floor table inside the allowlisted module docstring remain exact facts.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
Keep measured Bedrock cache/temperature/region/retry behavior; canonical relation partition and retired severity posture; bridge-project parity and committed-clean writes; blast-radius/repeat/size bug escalation plus claim-RCA sequence; ancestry/provenance rules; live push-mode reads; per-model marked-prefix cache floors; canary delegation; and candidate span failure/sanitization/nesting contracts. Real source/path consumers include `test_attestation_signing.py`, `test_web_tool_gating.py`, and `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_operation_snapshot_authoritative_binding.py`; the candidate oracle imports its owned harness. External provider/tracing modules remain documented consumers but are not added to the non-external focused command. No target docstring consumer was found.

- [ ] Prose changes occur only inside the 48 declared stable-ID blocks.
- [ ] Any changed blank line is adjacent to an edited stable-ID block.
- [ ] The normalized-AST comparison passes on every owned path.
- [ ] The token/comment comparison passes on every owned path.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts exactly 48 leaf-linked TSV rows, one for each declared stable-ID block.
- [ ] Every reviewer row uses this schema: stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session.
- [ ] Every before_citation equals f0ebace0b5d88e004a8b370f612501437365eccd:<path>#<stable-id>.
- [ ] Every final_citation equals <final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>.
- [ ] Every row records after_words < before_words.
- [ ] Every row records directives_exact=PASS.
- [ ] Every row records semantic-preservation=PASS, confirming its preserved_contract_or_consumer.
- [ ] Every row records bloat-removal=PASS, confirming removal of chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.
## Verification
The five current-base DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest with real consumers, scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check HEAD^..HEAD`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. The grouped commit also contains the 10 separate grounding paths on the companion leaf. They are the executable completion oracle.
